verdict.rationale: GitLab's Duo Agent Platform lets users create custom flows to automate team processes (gitlab-docs-36) and delegate routine tasks to agents (gitlab-docs-47). Agents turn issues into merge requests and remediate vulnerabilities while executing within the lifecycle (gitlab-docs-1, gitlab-docs-24), and sessions track the status and execution of those runs (gitlab-docs-37). CI/CD pipelines and the REST API add further automation (gitlab-docs-12, gitlab-docs-20). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of background or event/schedule triggers for agent flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the agents run autonomously.
